verdict.rationale: Fly.io is a cloud hosting platform, so a published uptime SLA with downtime credits is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the pack mentions an SLA, uptime commitment, or credit schedule. The community outage reports and managed Postgres high-availability claims concern reliability and failover features, not a contractual SLA, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can review a published uptime SLA with defined credits for downtime
